body.x: Seoul National University of Science & Technology, participated ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ held at COEX in Samseong-dong from October 17th (Tue) to 20th (Fri) and introduced ‘Specialized Business Achievements’.

The corresponding products and systems are, UV Robot based Vision Measurement System, Delta Robot using Tilting Stage, Vortex Cannon for 4D theater dimensional effect, and others. Professor Kim Young-Seok of Seoul National University of Science & Technology said, “The product has been prepared over several years by junior grades to senior grades”, and added, “ The main goal of educational business it to develop the engineer that can be sent to industrial site right away.”
